profile.name: 通用网络摄像头
profile.description: 通用网络摄像头，用于在实验中连续采集可见光图像或视频。支持曝光、增益、分辨率和帧率设置，常用于样品观察、实验过程监控和简单视觉对位。
profile.description_en: A generic webcam used to continuously capture visible-light images or video in laboratory workflows. It supports exposure, gain, frame size, and frame rate settings, and is commonly used for sample observation, experiment monitoring, and basic visual alignment.

registry.name: Webcam Capture
